note: Average net tariff = average over all customer types (basic tariff + fuel charge), January 2026. A commercial bill depends on the customer's tariff type, demand charges and the monthly fuel charge, so this is a screening value. Emission factor = CO2e per kWh of electricity sold, latest reported year.

CLP.name: CLP Power Hong Kong
CLP.tariff_source: CLP Power, '2026 Tariff Adjustment' press release, 18 Nov 2025: Average Net Tariff 140.6 cents/kWh from 1 Jan 2026
CLP.ef_source: CLP Holdings 2025 Sustainability Report, ESG data hub: CO2e intensity of electricity sold by CLP Power Hong Kong, 2025 = 0.34 kg/kWh
